# Version 4.158.0
> **Engine and rendering reliability** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.158.0-rc.1.26567.14)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.158.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158 previews Skia m158 with more reliable filtered images, glyph rendering and GPU failure handling. HarfBuzzSharp upgrades to native HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and adds 30 named script constants. SkiaSharp's managed binding surface remains unchanged while native fixes improve texture boundaries, displacement precision and resource handling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m158** — Moves the native renderer to milestone 158 and incorporates subsequent m158 fixes without changing SkiaSharp's managed API surface. ([#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634), [#5702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5702), [#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))

## API Surface

- **HarfBuzz script coverage** — HarfBuzzSharp adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, alongside native HarfBuzz 15.0.0. The existing Script struct, parsing, numeric conversions and 149 prior constants remain intact. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## Bug Fixes

- **Filtered image boundaries and precision** — Antialiased, skewed and minified draws retain texture-subset clamping when padding is insufficient, and Ganesh avoids mipmaps containing unwritten scratch texels. Displacement offsets use float precision to match filter bounds; image-filter cache equality now agrees with its bytewise hash. ([#5768](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5768), [#5712](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5712), [#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
- **Glyphs and GPU geometry** — Glyph rendering respects reloaded paths, formats and bounds, correctly crops FreeType LCD16 images, and clears incompatible masks. Reflected hairline caps and text-atlas selection are corrected; Graphite bounds clip recording and preserves painter order after full overwrites. ([#5739](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5739), [#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669), [#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
- **GPU failures and resource bounds** — Native Vulkan submissions account for synchronous fence-wait failures; GRContext.Submit remains void. Ganesh propagates flush failures and abandons unsafe contexts, but failed promise-image fulfillment remains nonfatal. Further fixes check buffer/MSAA sizes, constrain destination reads, and work around affected ARM device-loss timing and Imagination descriptor-pool destruction. ([#5712](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5712), [#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669), [#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Process-local hash seeding** — The shared hash-code polyfill uses OS-generated randomness instead of System.Random. Hash codes remain randomized between processes and stable within a process; the first use now initializes cryptography support. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0

Updates bundled HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing Script values and the struct-based programming model are preserved; removal of an unused internal deprecated import does not remove a public managed member.

## Release Candidate 1 (November 17, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 corrects antialiased texture-subset clamping, image-filter cache equality and mask-filtered glyph handling. Managed APIs remain unchanged.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17...v4.158.0-rc.1.26567.14)

## Preview 3 (November 13, 2026)

Preview 3 improves displacement precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait failure handling. The shared hash-code polyfill gains OS-generated seeding while keeping hashes stable within a process.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5...v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17)

## Preview 2 (November 9, 2026)

Preview 2 upgrades HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 Script constants. It also corrects reflected hairline caps, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, with a targeted ARM Vulkan device-loss workaround.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2...v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m158 without changing managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp's package revision moves to 14.4.0.300 while its native engine remains 14.4.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0...v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)
